description: This Java class 'EntitiesVersionControlController' is a REST controller for managing entity version control operations in the Thingsboard platform. It provides endpoints for creating, retrieving, comparing, and loading entity versions, as well as listing branches and versions, with security and permission checks.

classes.name: EntitiesVersionControlController
classes.description: REST controller for entity version control operations, including creating, retrieving, comparing, and loading entity versions, with security and permission checks.

methods.name: saveEntitiesVersion
methods.description: Creates a new version of entities or a single entity based on the provided request, returning a UUID for tracking.

methods.name: getVersionCreateRequestStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a previously requested entity version creation by request ID.

methods.name: listEntityVersions
methods.description: Lists versions for a specific entity in a branch, with pagination and search options.

methods.name: listEntityTypeVersions
methods.description: Lists versions of an entity type in a branch.

methods.name: listVersions
methods.description: Lists all available versions in a branch for all entity types.

methods.name: listEntitiesAtVersion
methods.description: Returns a list of remote entities of a specific type available at a specific version.

methods.name: listAllEntitiesAtVersion
methods.description: Returns all remote entities available in a specific version.

methods.name: getEntityDataInfo
methods.description: Retrieves short info about a remote entity at a specific version.

methods.name: compareEntityDataToVersion
methods.description: Compares current entity data with data at a specific version, returning the diff.

methods.name: loadEntitiesVersion
methods.description: Loads a specific version of remote entities or a single entity based on the request.

methods.name: getVersionLoadRequestStatus
methods.description: Retrieves the status of a previously made load request by request ID.

methods.name: listBranches
methods.description: Lists available branches in the remote repository, with default branch prioritization.
